function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on whether you’re looking for something local or something that can be delivered right to your door: | Option | What it offers | How to order | |--------|----------------|--------------| | **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often custom‑made cakes; great for special occasions | Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp, call the bakery, or visit their website. Many local shops now accept online orders via their own site or through platforms like **Etsy** or **Shopify**. | | **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, wide variety of flavors, custom designs | • **Goldbelly** – delivers specialty cakes from famous bakeries across the U.S.
• **Cake Delivery** – offers same‑day delivery in many cities.
• **Bakery.com** – a marketplace for local bakeries that ship nationwide. | | **Major grocery chains** | Convenient, often free delivery with subscription | • **Whole Foods** (via Amazon Prime) – offers a selection of cakes that can be delivered to your home.
• **Walmart Grocery** – has a “Bakery” section that ships to many areas. | | **Specialty cake makers** | Custom designs, themed cakes, wedding cakes | • **The Cake Shop** (online boutique) – specializes in custom wedding cakes.
• **Etsy** – search for “custom cake” and filter by “ship to [your country]”. | | **Subscription services** | Monthly cake deliveries, seasonal flavors | • **Cakes & Co.** – monthly cake subscription boxes.
• **Cratejoy** – offers cake subscription boxes from various makers. | ### Quick steps to place an order 1. **Decide on the type of cake** (birthday, wedding, custom design, etc.). 2. **Choose a provider** from the table above that fits your location and budget. 3. **Visit the website or call** the bakery. If ordering online, you’ll usually need to: - Select the cake size, flavor, and any custom text or decorations. - Provide delivery address and preferred delivery time. - Pay online (most sites accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay). 4. **Confirm the order** and keep the receipt or confirmation email handy. If you let me know your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local options for you!
